build_vit_b16_backbone: build a ViT-B/16 backbone with hooks at layers 2, 5, 8, 11 for feature extraction
build_vit_l16_backbone: build a ViT-L/16 backbone with 1024 features and hooks at layers 5, 11, 17, 23
build_deit_b16_backbone: build a DeiT-B/16 backbone with hooks at layers 2, 5, 8, 11 for feature extraction
build_vit_b_rn50_backbone: build a ViT-B/16 with ResNet50 backbone hybrid model using vit_only or combined features
run_forward_vit: run forward pass through pretrained ViT backbone to extract four multi-scale feature layers
